question: In which of the following states of India is the Pulicat lake located?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Pulicat lake is the **second-largest brackish water lake** in India located in the state of Andhra Pradesh after Chilika lake.
 
• It extends from the extreme southeastern portion of **Andhra Pradesh** to the adjacent portion of Tamil Nadu state.
